messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: pystan 2.0.0 status
parts:
Hello all,

PyStan 2.0.x is almost ready. I just pushed a feature branch (called
arg_refactor) which works with Stan tag v2.0.0. It has, however, a few bugs
(mostly with optimizing) that were introduced by my adapting to Stan's
arg_refactor. I'm working on them...

Best,

Allen

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] pystan 2.0.0 status
parts:
When it's done, I'll put a link up on the Stan home page.

I'm looking forward to getting users from the Python world
as well as the R world --- I'm guessing they'll be very
different types of users.

- Bob
